title: India touts homegrown 2-micron 5-axis CNC machines as it seeks local semiconductor equipment
html: India's electronics and IT minister Ashwini Vaishnaw said on November 14 that the country has developed indigenous five-axis precision CNC machines with 2-micron accuracy, and called for India to build its own machinery and high-precision components for...
